steps.say: Scientists test ideas to answer questions. A fair test is a test we can trust.
In a fair test, you change only one thing. You keep everything else the same.
steps.show: Change 1 thing. Keep the rest the same.

steps.say: Then you measure what happens. Use the right tool and the right unit.
Before you start, make a prediction. Say what you think will happen and why.
Repeat your measurements if you can. Similar results help you trust them.
To test balls, drop each one from the same height onto the same floor.
steps.show: Same height. Same floor. Different ball.

hints: Temperature is how hot or cold something is.
Think about what a doctor uses when you have a fever.
Look for the tool with a scale in °C.
check.explanation: A thermometer measures temperature in degrees Celsius (°C).

check.prompt: The unit cm is short for ___.
hints: Look at the letters c and m.
It is a unit on a ruler.
There are 100 of these in a metre.
check.explanation: cm is short for centimetres. A ruler is marked in centimetres.
